hints: Why can the prefix trick from `range-sum-mutable` not be reused here?
Because minimum cannot be undone: knowing the smallest of the first `to` readings and of the first `from` readings says nothing about the stretch between them.
So the structure has to cover the queried stretch directly, from pieces it already holds. Build a tree where each node covers a stretch and stores its smallest reading.
Then a query splits into the few nodes that exactly cover the stretch - at most two per level - and a change updates only the nodes above one leaf.
